propositions: Copilot, Codex, and Claude MCP clients must be configured to connect to the rebar MCP server over remote HTTP with static bearer token authentication.

Each client requires a distinct configuration file format (copilot: JSON, codex: TOML, claude: JSON) with bearer token sourced from environment variables (MCP_CLIENT_PAT_COPILOT, MCP_CLIENT_PAT_CODEX, MCP_CLIENT_PAT_CLAUDE).
Example client configs must be committed under examples/mcp-clients/ with no inline secrets, only environment variable references.

A hermetic test suite must validate that each committed example config loads correctly, resolves the bearer token from the environment, and successfully executes a real read tool (ticket show/list) against a loopback rebar-mcp instance.
The test must verify that invalid or absent bearer tokens result in 401 responses, confirming the Authorization header is on the request path.
Optional per-client CLI acceptance tests (skipped-with-reason when binaries unavailable) must confirm that copilot/codex/claude CLI commands recognize the example configs and list the rebar server.
